findings.message: Server "remote-proxy" runs mcp-remote@0.1.10, which matches advisory MCPA-2025-0001 (CVE-2025-6514): OS command injection when connecting to untrusted MCP servers. Upgrade to mcp-remote >= 0.1.16.
Tool "search_docs" contains hidden/invisible Unicode characters (possible hidden instructions): 4 zero-width characters (U+200B) hide the fragment "ignore previous instructions".
Server "mail" has a hardcoded secret in env var "SMTP_PASSWORD" — move it to an environment reference or OS keychain.
Filesystem server "filesystem" is granted overly broad root path(s): /home — scope it to the specific directories the agent needs.

Server "docs-helper" runs unpinned package "docs-helper-mcp" — every launch fetches whatever is latest (rug-pull / compromised-release exposure). Pin an exact version (e.g. docs-helper-mcp@2.1.0) and lock the tool surface with `agentgate lock`.
Remote server "notes" (notes.example.com) is configured without any authentication header — verify the endpoint enforces auth (e.g. OAuth) out of band.
Server "docs-helper" auto-confirms package installation (-y) — combined with an unpinned spec this installs new upstream code silently.
